items.title: Amazon RDS for Oracle now supports September 2026 Monthly Recommended Patch
items.content_snippet: Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) for Oracle now supports the September 2026 Monthly Recommended Patch (MRP) for Oracle Database version 19c and 26ai. An MRP is a minor engine version that builds on a quarterly Release Update (RU), bundling Oracle's Critical Security Patch Update (CSPU) with additional Oracle-recommended fixes. items.content_snippet: AWS Lambda now supports Seekable OCI (SOCI) for lazy loading Event Functions packaged as Open Container Initiative (OCI) images running on Lambda Managed Instances . With SOCI support, Lambda fetches only the files needed at each stage of the execution environment startup rather than downloading the entire image upfront, reducing container startup times by up to 70%. items.title: Introducing time series collections for the next generation of Amazon OpenSearch Serverless
items.content_snippet: Today, we're announcing support for time series collections on the next generation of Amazon OpenSearch Serverless. With time series collections, you can ingest, store, and analyze logs, metrics, traces, and event data without provisioning or managing clusters. They absorb ingest spikes automatically, keep recent data fast to query, and make months or years of history searchable at low cost, all in the same collection. items.title: Quick now supports smart approvals for agentic actions
items.content_snippet: Amazon Quick now supports smart approvals, a review layer that reduces unnecessary approval prompts while preserving human oversight of the actions that matter most. As agents take more actions on a user's behalf, such as sending email, updating records, and creating tickets, asking a person to approve every step leads to approval fatigue and weaker oversight over time. With smart approvals, a separate review model called the classifier evaluates each eligible action against the user's request.

items.title: Amazon ECS Managed Instances adds cross-instance and Spot consolidation
items.content_snippet: Today, Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) Managed Instances introduces two infrastructure optimization updates: cross-instance and Spot consolidation. Cross-instance consolidation evaluates tasks running across multiple underutilized instances together, packing them onto fewer instances to raise utilization and lower costs. items.content_snippet: AWS Lambda announces the Durable Execution Telemetry Exporter plugin for Lambda durable functions. This new observability plugin captures the step-by-step history of your durable executions and sends them to one or more destinations of your choice. You can use the exported data to gather operational and business insights and keep history beyond the standard retention period.
